use_when.text: Use Single for short answers, such as an item name, a station or a date.
Use Multi for longer answers, such as describing the item or where it was lost.
Use Password Hidden for passwords, and Password Shown after the eye is tapped.
Turn on Icon Right with the chevron when the field opens a list or a date picker.
Use Error when an answer is missing or wrong, and say how to fix it in the Helper.

dont_use_when.text: Do not hide the label. The placeholder is not a label.
Do not put instructions people need while typing in the placeholder. Use the Helper.
Do not use Single for passwords or for text longer than one line.
Do not show Error before the person has had a chance to answer.
Do not recolour the field outside the bound tokens.

best_practice.text: Set the width to Fill in forms so the fields line up, and keep one field per row on mobile.
Change the height with the density mode on the frame, not by hand.

placement.text: In forms at Fill width, with one field per row on mobile.

pairs_with.how: Icon Right shows chevron-down at Size md, replaceable through Icon Right swap
Password types show eye / eye-off inside the show-password toggle button

a11y.text: The <label> is tied to the control with htmlFor and a generated id.
Renders a native <input> (Single and password types) or <textarea> (Multi); password types switch the input type between password and text.
The Helper is linked with aria-describedby when it is shown.
State Disabled sets the native disabled attribute on the control and on the password toggle.
The password toggle is a <button type="button"> labelled "Show password" or "Hide password", with aria-pressed reflecting Password Shown.
With Show label false no <label> renders and the control has no other accessible name.
Connect the label to the input with a for and id pair, or wrap the input in the label.
Link the helper and error text with aria-describedby. On Error, set aria-invalid="true" and describe the problem in words.
Build the eye as a button labelled "Show password" or "Hide password" with aria-pressed, and switch the input type between password and text.
Use the disabled attribute only when the field truly cannot be used. Explain why nearby.
Placeholder and helper text are above 4.5:1. The default border is above 3:1 in Light and Dark.
